subsystems.name: Entangled photon source
subsystems.role: creates pairs of photons whose states are correlated, the raw material of every link.
parts: nonlinear crystal for spontaneous parametric down-conversion, or semiconductor quantum dot

subsystems.name: Quantum memory
subsystems.role: stores a photon's quantum state and releases it later on demand, so links can be joined.
parts: diamond nitrogen-vacancy centre, trapped ion, cold atom cloud or rare-earth-doped crystal
optical cavity to boost light-matter coupling

subsystems.name: Wavelength interface
subsystems.role: matches the emitter's wavelength to the 1550 nm band where fibre loss is lowest.

subsystems.name: Bell-state measurement station
subsystems.role: the swapping operation — entangles two memories that never interacted by measuring two photons jointly.

subsystems.name: Purification and error handling
subsystems.role: trades many lower-fidelity links for fewer better ones.

subsystems.name: Control and synchronisation
subsystems.role: keeps distant nodes phase-locked and timed to picoseconds.

buildSteps.title: Choose a memory platform
buildSteps.detail: Each candidate — diamond colour centres, rare-earth crystals, cold atoms, trapped ions — trades coherence time against bandwidth and ease of fibre coupling.

buildSteps.title: Make efficient single photons
buildSteps.detail: A pumped nonlinear crystal or an electrically driven quantum dot emits photon pairs on demand with high purity and near-unity collection into fibre.

buildSteps.title: Store and retrieve
buildSteps.detail: A photon is absorbed into the memory's collective excitation, held for microseconds to milliseconds, and read out on command as a photon with the original state.

buildSteps.title: Link two nodes
buildSteps.detail: Photons from two memories interfere on a beamsplitter; a successful joint detection signals that the memories are now entangled.

buildSteps.title: Swap and extend
buildSteps.detail: At the midpoint of a longer span, a Bell-state measurement on photons from two adjacent links joins them into one longer entangled link.

buildSteps.title: Purify
buildSteps.detail: Because each swap adds noise, several copies of a link are combined so that the surviving one has higher fidelity than any input.

buildSteps.title: Multiplex
buildSteps.detail: Many memory modes and wavelength channels are operated in parallel so that the low probability of success per attempt still yields a usable rate.

buildSteps.title: Deploy in fibre
buildSteps.detail: Nodes, detectors and timing hardware are installed in real ducts with classical synchronisation traffic sharing the same cable.

prerequisites.why: near-unity efficiency and low dark counts are needed to catch the fragile photons, and these are commercially supplied today.

prerequisites.tech: Low-loss telecom fibre and QKD hardware
prerequisites.why: the transmission medium and much of the optics already exist and are deployed for quantum key distribution.

prerequisites.tech: Long-coherence quantum memories with efficient light interfaces
prerequisites.why: laboratory memories reach useful coherence times, but combining that with high retrieval efficiency and telecom compatibility is unsolved.

prerequisites.tech: Entanglement swapping and purification at high fidelity
prerequisites.why: swapping between two memory nodes has been demonstrated, but fidelity and rates remain far below what a network needs.
visible-band emitters must be shifted to 1550 nm without destroying entanglement; shown in labs with added noise to control.
thousands of stable interferometers and detectors must fit into field-deployable, serviceable hardware.

pathway.milestone: two-node entanglement across installed metro fibre and small multi-node laboratory networks
pathway.unlocks: proof that memories, photons and swapping work together outside a bench.

pathway.milestone: three-to-five-node chains with swapping at one or two intermediate stations and memory multiplexing
pathway.unlocks: rates high enough for device-independent cryptography and early quantum-network services.

pathway.milestone: field-deployed repeater segments operating at the distances where direct fibre transmission fails
pathway.unlocks: city-to-city entanglement without trusted intermediate nodes.

pathway.milestone: repeater chains combined with free-space satellite links (as demonstrated by the Micius mission)
pathway.unlocks: continental-scale entanglement distribution and, eventually, a quantum internet linking processors.
